title: Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation — CRMS / CCRS (Comprehensive Complaint Redressal System)
summary: AMC runs a public complaint system branded CCRS (Comprehensive Complaint Redressal System) / 'AMC Seva 311', reachable via the 155303 helpline, the amccrs.com web portal, the 'AMC CCRS' mobile app, WhatsApp, SMS, IVR and Twitter. The complaint REGISTRATION taxonomy is publicly enumerable (it is rendered in the public registration form). A public dashboard publishes LIVE AGGREGATE counters (registered/closed/reopened today and this month) and has dashboard scaffolding for SLA / zone / ward / department breakdowns. What is NOT published: any downloadable or historical dataset, machine-readable open data, ward/department-wise time series, or annual complaint reports. There is no fabrication here; counts below are the live figures observed on the dashboard on the as_of date and are point-in-time only.

availability.http_status_verified: 200 (curl, browser UA, 2026-06-09) for both amccrs.com registration page and amcmodules.ahmedabadcity.gov.in complaint list
availability.scrapable: Partially. The registration FORM exposes the full category list and the 47-ward list (scrapable). The dashboard publishes live aggregate counters (scrapable from rendered page). The granular SLA/zone/ward/department charts are JS-rendered and did not populate on fetch; no export/CSV/API is offered. No historical or per-complaint open dataset is published.
what_is_available: Full complaint-category taxonomy (rendered in the public registration form dropdown).
Full list of 47 AMC wards used for routing.
Registration channels (Online, Mobile App, IVR, Missed Call, SMS, WhatsApp, Twitter, In Person, Telephonic, Email, Vendor, CNCD Junction, Nayan Night Round).
Live aggregate counters on Dashb.aspx: complaints registered / closed / reopened, for 'today' and 'current month'.
A public complaint-status lookup (track by complaint number / phone).
Dashboard SCAFFOLDING (labels only, JS-rendered) for: Within-SLA vs Beyond-SLA, Zone-wise, Ward-wise, Department-wise, Top-10 longest-open complaints.
what_is_NOT_available: No downloadable / machine-readable open dataset (no CSV / API / data.gov.in feed).
No published historical time series of complaints by ward or department.
No published annual or monthly complaint report (PDF) located on ahmedabadcity.gov.in.
No published per-category resolution rate, pendency rate, or exact SLA-in-days table.
Granular SLA/ward/department charts exist as dashboard widgets but data did not render on fetch and is not exportable.

helpline.tier: A (helpline/email from portal+aggregator); 1800 number tier B (news/aggregator)

stats_if_any.caveat: POINT-IN-TIME ONLY — these are live counters scraped from the public dashboard on 2026-06-09, NOT an official cumulative or audited statistic. They are recorded to show the dashboard publishes real numbers, not to assert a rate. Do not extrapolate.
stats_if_any.observation_tier_C: On the observed snapshot, monthly closures (~19,973) tracked ~82% of monthly registrations (~24,376); this is a single-day snapshot of in-month flow, NOT a resolution rate. AMC does not publish a verifiable closed-within-SLA percentage in machine-readable form.
stats_if_any.tier: A (figures are from the official AMC dashboard) but explicitly point-in-time

ownership_routing_finding.headline: Every category a citizen CAN file in CCRS routes to an AMC department. The civic functions AMC has carved out to UNELECTED bodies have NO complaint category in CCRS at all — so the system both (a) routes you only to AMC, and (b) renders the unelected city invisible by omission.

carved_out_functions_absent_from_crms.note: CCRS handles streetLIGHT (the city's lamp) but NOT electricity supply — that complaint goes to a private company, not AMC.

carved_out_functions_absent_from_crms.function: Master plan / town-planning scheme / land-use / development permission area
carved_out_functions_absent_from_crms.note: CCRS has only a thin 'Town Planning - Other' stub; structural planning grievances are AUDA's, an unelected state authority.
No transport complaint category in CCRS; routes to separate transport bodies.
CCRS has 'Traffic Signal Stop Line' (civil marking, AMC) but enforcement is state police.

biggest_data_gap: There is NO published, downloadable, historical complaint dataset — no CSV/API, no per-ward or per-department time series, no annual report, and no verifiable closed-within-SLA rate. The dashboard shows live aggregate counters and has SLA/ward/department widgets, but those granular charts are JS-rendered, non-exportable, and reset to 'today/this month' — making any audit of WHICH wards or departments are starved, or how long the poor wait vs the rich, impossible from public data. The taxonomy and helpline are open; the accountability numbers are effectively closed.
